body.x: Technology-based vegan food startup Nuldam, operated by JOINANDJOIN, participated in CES 2023 in Las Vegas, USA, for four days from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time). JOINANDJOIN has been researching and developing vegan raw materials since its establishment. And around April last year, it established the first vegan nutrition research institute in Korea that focuses on vegan and nutritional foods and raw materials.

It continues to study technologies based on food engineering and is speeding up the development of egg substitutes, vegetable dairy substitutes, viscosity control and functional materials, and vegetable flavoring. At CES 2023, it presented Nuldam Vegan Milk Original, Vegan Croissant and Bagel, Vegan Butter and Cream Cheese, and Vegan Milk Barista Edition. JOINANDJOIN previously debuted these Nuldam products at the 2022 Seoul Cafe Show.

body.x: Neoldam Vegan Milk Original makes the taste and aroma closest to milk through more than 15 plant-based raw material tests and features the same white color as milk even after sterilization with its technology. In addition, it targets customers who have difficulty drinking milk due to lactose intolerance by matching the same calcium content as milk.

Nuldam is showing steady growth, with a more than 120% increase in transactions compared to last year. "Thanks to the steady growth in the domestic market, it will be a meaningful time to understand trends in overseas vegan and food tech markets," an official from Nuldam said. "This year, we will further strengthen the export sector to show the power of Korean vegan foods to the world."
